event.title: UN Chief Calls for Global Support for Syria's Recovery
event.canonical_title: UN Chief Calls for Global Support for Syria's Recovery
event.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres visited Syria, marking the first official visit by a UN chief in 17 years. During his visit, he met with interim President Ahmed al-Sharaa and emphasized that Syria is at a 'pivotal moment' in its recovery from civil war. Guterres urged the international community to provide support to aid the country's rebuilding efforts.
